todo: The prior GERD suggestion was withdrawn because PMID 35362447 evaluates psychosocial disorders through anxiety/depression-oriented evidence rather than adjustment disorder as a condition-specific exposure. Reconsider only with adjustment-disorder-specific clinical evidence that supports the proposed downstream diagnosis and preserves relationship direction, chronology, and competing causes.

ME-41 safe-draft rescreen 2026-09-12 (NCBI E-utilities) re-tested the proposed depressive-disorder progression edge and found no source supporting it as a comorbidity association. Casey, "Adjustment disorder: epidemiology, diagnosis and treatment" (CNS Drugs 2009;23(11):927-38, PMID 19845414) frames the relationship to major depression as a differential-diagnosis boundary rather than a co-occurrence finding: adjustment disorder is a longitudinal diagnosis anchored to an identified stressor while major depression is a cross-sectional diagnosis based on symptom counts, and the review calls that distinction a classificatory conundrum. Mitchell et al., a meta-analysis of 94 interview-based studies (Lancet Oncol 2011;12(2):160-74, PMID 21251875), reports depression and adjustment-disorder prevalences separately within oncological, haematological, and palliative-care populations and does not establish co-occurrence between the two identities, so it also carries a population mismatch against a general adjustment-disorder primary. The FINAL-CLOSE-DIRECTION resolution recorded at ME-30 therefore remains in force.
